nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): The Snowflake explore sub-agent returns only the complete four-segment aggregate, latest 12-month revenue trend, top-five products, and total controls, including every order status.

explore 1 (enterprise-data-analyst 1): The WooCommerce explore sub-agent fully paginates products, orders, and customers at `perPage=100`, omitting the optional order-status argument. For each sold line item, join its product and assign revenue to only the first listed product category (`categories[0].name`); do not explode all category memberships, and exclude rows with no first category from the category table. Return category revenue and distinct sold-product count by that first category, plus all-status total customer/order/revenue/AOV and page/join controls. Do not persist raw rows or modify the store.

explore 2 (financial-market-analyst 0): The Yahoo Finance explore sub-agent issues the three independent latest-record calls for `^DJI`, `AMZN`, and `JPM` and returns exact symbol, latest date/close, and `longName`.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): The Excel coder solely creates `Executive_Dashboard.xlsx`. Use bulk writes for exactly four sheets. `Ecommerce_Performance` must contain exactly one row per non-null first category observed in sold order line items, sorted by revenue descending; `Product_Count` is distinct sold products in that category and every row uses the same all-status overall AOV. Write exactly the five Unified_Dashboard KPI rows and literal target/status/source values.

coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): The PowerPoint coder solely creates `Executive_Briefing.pptx` under one presentation ID. Create exactly eight slides with the exact requested titles/content, use at most one bounded populate operation per slide, save once, and extract the full deck text once.
